title: Keep the admitted AMP dataset in the repository
summary: CONTRIBUTING now permits an admitted training dataset under 20 MB in the checkout, with its manifest and review record. Raw native runs stay outside. The priors guide tells you to export the reviewed AMP bank under locomotion/priors/datasets/ and commit it.
next: The program lead exports the reviewed 18,000-pair bank into locomotion/priors/datasets/ and commits it with its manifest and review record.
reason: A storage rule for reviewed datasets changes no measured result, roadmap marker or gate.
